answer.explanation: Order is a domain entity, and it imports the typeorm package for the @Entity() decorator. That ties the domain model to a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because domain code should stay free of infrastructure and framework dependencies. The project documents this case on purpose: a comment in Order.ts and a row in docs/legacy-exceptions.md allow the TypeORM decorator on Order until 2026-12-31. The reason given is that the ORM mapping moves to infrastructure in the persistence split. Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception has not expired. The README points to that file as the list of known exceptions.
